Messages.Author: jeff...@pacbell.net
Messages.Body:
Suppose Samuel Haight got a Drum of Xipe Totec and a Veneficorum Atrum
Sanguis? Could he, or any other ally for that matter, perhaps Talaq or
Rafastio Ghouls, play Celerity and Thaumaturgy cards at CEL and THA as
a vampire?

Jeff

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:


No. Each one says, "The _vampire_ with this equipment..."

--Colin McGuigan

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Card text on Drum/Veneficorum: "The vampire with this equipment..."
Samuel Haight is not a vampire, nor is he playing Drum/Veneficorum as a
vampire, so the Drum/Veneficorum doesn't treat him like one and therefore
provides no boost to him.

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
jeff...@pacbell.net wrote:
> Interesting. So suppose a hypothetical ally had text "...can play
> minion cards as a vampire." Could this ally tool up with Discipline
> Equipment and use any corresponding minion cards as a vampire?

No, because even if they could play the Drum of Xipe Topec as a vampire,
it would not treat them as a vampire while in play.

Samual Haight or Talaq may, eg, get a Rutor's Hand, but it doesn't help
them.

--Colin McGuigan
